_note: Demo products (PRD F8). createdBy is a user name. Seed materials, rate sheets and rules use all six, so all six are active.

products.name: Personal loan
products.description: Unsecured fixed-rate loans with terms of 12 to 60 months.

products.name: Credit card
products.description: Cash back card with an intro APR on purchases and balance transfers for the first 12 months.

products.name: Mortgage
products.description: 15- and 30-year fixed-rate home loans, including mortgage prequalification.

products.name: HELOC
products.description: Variable-rate home equity line of credit with a 10-year draw, up to 80% combined loan-to-value.

products.name: Auto loan
products.description: Loans for new vehicles (up to 72 months) and used vehicles from model year 2019 (up to 60 months).

products.name: Savings
products.description: Share savings accounts and 12-month share certificates.
